paper_verdict.estimator_family: FE (panel fixed effects with lagged dependent variable; pooled OLS and RE also reported)
paper_verdict.pooling_concerns: Outcome is the first difference of ln GDP per capita (growth rate; table labels it 'lnPCGDP') and exposure is a log level, so coefficients are semi-elasticity-type and not comparable to level or elasticity estimates. Pooled, FE and RE rows and the full-sample/subsample rows use the same data, so they are not independent; broadband rows reuse the same sample. Only the lagged dependent variable is lagged, exposure is contemporaneous; authors concede reverse causality remains and describe results as associations.
